subject: [hw] DONE V34: Android runtime shims + data imports, 2031 unit + 103 real-loader checks
body:
DONE V34 (shim/n2shim_android.c, shim/n2shim_props.c, shim/test_v34). Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published. Commit f791631.

Test commands (work-tree root):
  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v34/run_tests.sh
Last line:
  N2TEST V34 PASS 2031/2031
The same run prints:
  N2TEST V34 PASS 2031/2031        (unit, ASan+UBSan -O1)
  N2TEST V34 PASS 2031/2031        (unit, plain -O2)
  N2TEST V34 PASS 2028/2028        (unit, TSan -O1; the deliberate guest-fault case is compiled out because V02 s SIGSEGV->siglongjmp recovery is not TSan-compatible)
  N2TEST V34CORE PASS 103/103      (V03 s real loader + the phone s own libvcodec_utility.so)
About 68 s, two clang jobs at a time, artifacts only under /tmp/n2hw-v34.
Extra check: bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v34/compile_ios.sh -> N2TEST V34-IOS PASS 2/2 (arm64-apple-ios16.5, compile only).

Implemented (all 35 names of D01 s android table, in that exact set, plus the 2 data imports):
- __android_log_print / __android_log_vprint through the n2shim_log callback and V30 s n2fmt (1024-byte cut, NULL format/va_list handled, never prints).
- property_get over a 203-key table in n2shim_props.c. 6 keys carry the phone s real values from its own build.prop (ro.build.type=user, ro.vendor.mtk_config_max_dram_size=0x800000000, ro.vendor.mtk_sec_video_path_support=1, ro.vendor.mtk_tee_gp_support=1, ro.vendor.mtk_trustonic_tee_support=1, ro.vendor.have_aee_feature=1); the other 197 are property-shaped strings in the five objects that are unset on this phone, so property_get returns the CALLER S DEFAULT exactly like Android and does not report them. An unknown key returns the default and is reported once (bounded at 32 distinct keys). The test extracts the keys from the five objects with the real `strings` and fails if a key is not in the table.
- atrace_get_enabled_tags = 64-bit 0, atrace_*_body no-ops, perf_lock_acq/rel = 0, sec_drv_base_check/info_update = 0 (callers are libvcodec_utility.so drvb_fc/drvb_f2, both void and discard the result; the real callee needs the secure world; documented in STATUS).
- ion/mt_ion over `const struct n2vc_hw *n2shim_hw`: an ion handle IS a dma handle, ion_mmap is n2vc_dma_guest_map, and the two address queries return the dma pa. Command numbers and struct offsets read off the vendor call sites: ion_custom_ioctl(fd, 1 (ION_CMD_MULTIMEDIA), {mm_cmd=8 (ION_MM_GET_IOVA), handle@8, module@12}) -> phy_addr at struct offset 32 (utility 0x1809a / vpud_vcodec 0xb17c); ion_custom_ioctl(fd, 0 (ION_CMD_SYSTEM), {sys_cmd=1 (ION_SYS_GET_PHYS), handle@8}) -> phy_addr@12, len@16 (vpud_vcodec 0xafa0); CONFIG_BUFFER and CACHE_SYNC accepted with no output. ion_mmap takes 7 args (fd, addr, len, prot, flags, share_fd, 32-bit offset) at both call sites.
- dlopen/dlsym/dlclose/dlerror/dladdr restricted to the loaded n2elf set (global handle for NULL, per-object handles for loaded sonames via an integrator registry or a representative defined symbol, dlsym = n2elf_sym, dlerror/dli_fname/dli_sname in GUEST memory, dladdr s saddr from n2elf_sym). The three vendor dlopen names (AVCSecureVdecCA.so, HEVCSecureVdecCA.so, /vendor/lib/libmtcloader.so) are not in the set and every call site handles NULL; that keeps the secure decoder and the thermal-policy hook off.
- log/exp2 as IEEE-754 double in the armeabi-v7a soft-float ABI (r0:r1 in and out), the only users are libvcodecdrv s H.264 POC computation.
- __cxa_atexit records (32, LIFO), __cxa_finalize runs matching handlers (really calls guest code), __register_atfork dropped, __libc_init calls guest main(argc,argv,envp) from the runner s globals or from vpud s raw_args, runs atexit, records n2shim_libc_status and sets c->stop_request; the structors array is deliberately not traversed because the loader already ran the init arrays.
- __gnu_Unwind_Find_exidx = 0, __aeabi_unwind_cpp_pr0 = no-op; n2shim_data_all = __stack_chk_guard (0x4e325634) and stderr (4-byte cell holding 2, the FILE* value V33 knows).

Not done / limits (also in gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V34/STATUS.md):
- Not run on the phone and not linked into a product build; iOS is a compile-only cross-compile of the two sources.
- The ion path is tested against a fake n2vc_hw and a stand-in DMA mirror, not V41 s real n2vc_dma. n2shim_android.c defines weak n2vc_dma_guest_map/unmap (-ENOSYS) so the set links without V41; V41 s strong definitions override them (verified by linking V30+V32+V33+V34 in one binary, one n2shim_log, no duplicate symbols).
- ion_alloc s heap_mask is ignored (one pool); align is passed through but n2vc_hw has no alignment parameter, so an alignment above the back end s page size is logged once and not honoured.
- Ion failures return -errno; the guest errno is V33 s and is not set.
- dladdr leaves dli_fbase at 0 (the frozen loader API has no address->image query).
- A share fd not created in this process cannot be imported unless the AP side publishes it with n2shim_ion_register_share(); nothing in the encoder path needs that today.
- Loader finding reported to hw-v03/hw-lead: n2elf_describe compares an unmasked (Thumb-bit) st_value with an even offset, so describe(exact Thumb function start) returns the previous symbol; the dladdr shim works around it, so it is not a blocker here.

Files changed: gpu/hwcodec/shim/n2shim_android.c (new), gpu/hwcodec/shim/n2shim_props.c (new), gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v34/** (new: run_tests.sh, compile_ios.sh, t_unit.c, t_core.c, t_support.c, t_v34.h, guest_thumb.s, gen_blob.py, gen_props.py), gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V34/STATUS.md (new). No file outside gpu/hwcodec/shim/{n2shim_android.c,n2shim_props.c,test_v34/**} touched.

Staying available for review findings.
